crossRefs.note: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

translations.web: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
translations.bsb: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
translations.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
translations.asv: But I permit not a woman to teach, nor to have dominion over a man, but to be in quietness.
